outcome: complications (missing string, bleeding, pain, vaginal discharge, perforation of uterus)
cohort: The first 127 mothers who delivered vaginally and the first 127 mothers who underwent caesarean section out of 1345 patients who received PPIUCD insertion.
finding: The study suggests that PPIUCD in caesarean section as well as in vaginal delivery is a convenient opportunity which should not be missed in countries like ours with high rates of unplanned and short interval pregnancies with limited access to health care providers.
mod_finding: PPIUCD insertion following both vaginal delivery and caesarean section had low expulsion rates and acceptable complication profiles at 3 months follow-up.
